product_one_liner.value: Rivo automates idle-cash management for households by investing excess money from existing checking accounts in short-term U.S. Treasury bills and returning funds before bills are due.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage has no pricing link in its visible navigation/footer, and the /pricing URL did not return a page; the FAQ does state a fee but is not a pricing page.

named_customers.notes: The homepage has testimonials but does not name the testimonial-givers; I found no two publicly named Rivo fintech customers.

employee_band.notes: The sources conflict: LinkedIn lists 7 employees and a 2–10 size band, while BusinessWire reported 10–20; the available evidence does not establish one of the requested bands.

founded_year.notes: The Rivo company profile identifies 2025 as its founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The visible blog material is fundraising and consumer-facing product/finance explanation, not two engineering-authored posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The public materials provide a single FAQ page, but no multi-article product documentation/help center or developer portal.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current careers board identifies rivofi.com and says no jobs are found.

model_provider.notes: The FAQ, blog, and Trust Center/subprocessor list reviewed do not identify an AI model or model provider used by the product.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Center names SOC 2; CCPA is also displayed there but is not among the requested certifications.

last_funding.notes: The $2.7M seed round was announced August 4, 2026; the same announcement says total funding was $3.1M.

raised_18mo.notes: The August 2026 seed round falls within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current careers board identifies rivofi.com and reports no jobs found.

launched_6mo.notes: Rivo announced its launch out of beta on August 4, 2026, within the six-month window before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No dated C-level/VP appointment or departure could be verified, and the available company material does not provide a complete date-stamped team roster.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable FAQ and subprocessor list name financial/security partners, not CRM or sales/marketing systems.
